0022600207.text: The Dallas Mavericks, 5-4 and fourth in the Southwest 2.5 games back, host the Indiana Pacers, 3-7 and 11th in the East, in the Mavericks' 11th game of the season. Dallas is riding a one-game winning streak and is 3-2 at home, while Indiana has lost its last game and is 0-5 at home. Dallas leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after its 121-105 win in Indianapolis on October 23, and it also won both meetings in 2025-26 by a combined 2-0. Dallas will be without Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee, strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel, inflammation), while Indiana will be without Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery), Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring, strain), and T.J. McConnell (hamstring, strain), who is day-to-day and a game-time decision.
